provenance.splitPolicy: 50/50 stratified by query category (15 tuning + 15 holdout per category)

provisionalGates.rationale: Initial planning targets for public search evaluation (#44). Explicitly provisional until target hardware, offered load, query-class weights, and maintainer-reviewed judgments are frozen. Any gate revision must append an entry to revisionHistory with a recorded justification.

read_heavy_low_churn.description: Low publication churn, steady reader traffic.

balanced.description: Moderate authoring/publishing cadence with regular searches.

high_churn.description: Frequent edits/publications relative to search volume.

networkEnergyEstimate.note: Parameterized network-transfer estimate only; never combined into measured CPU-package or whole-system energy counters.
